svg.title: Pontik Cluster: automatic failover
svg.desc: Two hand-drawn diagrams of the same two-node Eclipse Open Integration Engine™ cluster when node-1 fails. With one active node, as many teams run it today, the channel stops: new files wait in the SFTP inbox until someone starts node-2 by hand. With Pontik Cluster, nothing renews node-1's lease, so it runs out on the database clock; node-2 takes the lease and picks up the waiting files. When node-1 comes back, it stays on standby and does not take the channel back.
